protocol:
# R29: isolated runtime expert pool

Implementation source commit: fa4afd46c0e6b5fc8fbf139210e75ef5c051bc44.
This is an operator correctness campaign, not model inference or a throughput A/B.
Engine source is unchanged from R28. Production inference never instantiates this pool.
The existing scheduler fixture enables the new mode only with --expert-pool.

Freeze Release/native/Ninja/Vulkan and all loaded libraries, compiler, Mesa/RADV,
kernel and the exact environment. GPU must be RX 6800/RADV, without CPU fallback
for resident graphs. Require global VRAM <3 GiB before each GPU process.
Do not change clocks, voltage or power limit.

Use 256 original experts/top8 and 12 persistent slots in one layer instance.
Gate/up dimensions: 256 x 256; down: 256 x 8.
Types: F32/F32/F32, Q4_K/Q4_K/Q4_K, Q4_K/Q6_K/Q4_K,
Q4_K/Q4_K/Q6_K. Inputs F32. Tokens: 1,3,33; broadcast on/off;
ID storage contiguous or stride16 with offset4 bytes. Total 48 combinations.
For each, run 8 requests: cold, reordered all-hit, mixed hits/misses,
union over capacity when tokens>1, repeated255 within top8,
repeated0/255 within top8, eviction to248..255, reordered all-hit after eviction.
Repeated experts across tokens are allowed. Duplicates within a token bypass
without changing the cache; CPU full weights execute the original request.

Every resident graph must match full weights on the same target backend bit
for bit for gate, up, and down, with all three vectors finite and nonzero.
For F32 gate/up also require exact scalar dyadic dot products.
Every bypass must match full CPU weights bit for bit, finite and nonzero.
No relaxed tolerance, GPU/CPU quantized equivalence assumption or hashing of
invalid vectors. Raw dumps contain gate/up/down for all 8 requests, including
fallbacks, in quant,tokens,broadcast,strided,pass order; little-endian F32.

Require exact counters: per combination 20 unique misses,8 evictions;
hits28/20 for1/3-or33 tokens. Ready6/5 and bypass2/3 respectively.
Every upload consists of all three exact quantized source slices; upload_bytes
must equal misses times triplet bytes. Count API payload, not measured PCIe traffic.
The reordered all-hit requests must upload zero bytes. Remap preserves top-k order.
While a graph lease is outstanding, a second acquire must reject without mutation.
Release waits for completion before slots can be reused. Destruction waits too.
Management checks capacities1/2/4/8, unavailable/byte-budget/invalid geometry,
layer isolation, deterministic LRU, cancel before submission and retry.
This single-lease design does not validate concurrent pools or partial CPU/GPU merge.

Run the complete CPU Release suite, complete Vulkan suite twice, full CPU ASAN/UBSAN
where recorded, and existing default CPU/Vulkan scheduler modes for compatibility.
Raw completeness: 48*8*3 =1152 vectors,78,807,040 bytes per complete process.
GPU repeats must be byte-identical. CPU/GPU cross-backend equality is not required.

Preserve the initial failing duplicate-input campaign and a reduced control with
original pool source. Rebuild that control against unchanged B1 headers/libraries.
Failure reproduced with B1 is ERRORE_BASELINE for this synthetic duplicate-top8
operator input. Do not infer that normal model routing or current B4 is defective.
No model tokens/s, TTFT, quality score, miss latency or default promotion follows
from passing this isolated fixture. Next gate is opt-in scheduler integration and
same-backend/model correctness before a preregistered timing/memory A/B.
